$comment: The public impact ledger. Update this by hand, and keep it honest: it is the whole basis of the transparency claim on pages/support.html. Ship it at zero rather than at an invented figure. Never round up, never include a pledge that has not arrived, and always say what the money was actually spent on.
policy: Voluntary personal support. Not a purchase. Not tax-deductible.
Donations are processed by PayPal. CyberPulseAcademy never sees or stores your card details.
Hosting is near zero on GitHub Pages, so support pays for writing and reviewing exercise batches, not for infrastructure.
Every entry names the work it funded. If the money is unspent, say so instead of inventing an allocation.
